widgets_values: One continuous unedited cinematic tracking shot, medium wide view of a woman in a dark green coat walking steadily from left to right along a wet stone sidewalk beside a red brick wall, carrying a small tan leather bag. She walks at a constant natural pace, her arms swing gently and her coat moves with each step. The camera tracks smoothly sideways at her walking speed, maintaining the same framing and distance. Overcast soft daylight, realistic skin, stable neutral colors, subtle film texture. No cuts, no transitions, no sudden camera changes. Audio: continuous soft outdoor city ambience and evenly paced footsteps on wet pavement, no music, no dialogue.
